output.explanation: captureOrder POSTed to /v2/checkout/orders/{id}/capture without a PayPal-Request-Id header. If the response was lost and the call was retried, PayPal saw a brand-new request instead of replaying the original result. The capture call now sends a PayPal-Request-Id derived from the order (`capture-${orderID}`), so every retry for the same order reuses the same key and gets back the original capture outcome rather than a duplicate attempt or an ORDER_ALREADY_CAPTURED error.
